MULTICAST provides a chance for a building to cycle or trigger one or more additional times.
ACCELERATE immediately reduces a building's cycle cooldown by the specified amount of time.
EVASION provides a chance for the ark to completely avoid an enemy attack.
ARMOR reduces the Morale loss from enemy attacks. (Negative Armor increases Morale loss or damage.)

CHALLENGE spawns an additional enemy, up to a maximum of 3 enemies.
Many buildings can be UPGRADED by dropping additional copies of that building onto itself.
Surplus provides a CYCLE SPEED BONUS to all buildings on the ark. The more surplus , the greater the bonus.
IGNITED deals 1 damage per stack every 2s. Max stacks: 99. Stacks expire every 2s.
FREEZE causes the target (if the ark, then a random building; if an enemy, then that enemy) to cease cycling or triggering for the duration.
SLOWED reduces global cycle speed by 4% per stack. Max stacks: 99. Stacks expire every 3s.
CORRODED reduces Armor by 1 per stack. (Negative Armor increases Morale loss or damage.) Max stacks: 99. Stacks expire every 3s.
